description: CL:0000939 (CD16-positive, CD56-dim NK cell, human) does not distinguish CD57-negative (NK1) from CD57-positive (NK3) substates; both SOULCAP rows currently map to the same CL term at Broad match type.

No human-specific "group 1 innate lymphoid cell" CL term exists, unlike group 2 (CL:0001081) and group 3 (CL:0001078); confirmed by direct OLS4 search returning zero hits for the human-qualified query.

SOULCAP row has all four marker columns (Required/Ideal exclusion, Required/Ideal phenotypic markers) completely empty in the master sheet — there is no marker definition to match against at all, so no CL candidate can be derived from markers. Distinct from the more specific "T3" (Transitional B cell 3) row, which does have marker data.

Sheet's Full Name reads "Cytotoxice Natural Killer Cell" (typo, extra trailing "e"); this broke batch lexical search entirely for the row (zero OLS4 hits). Marker-based match was unaffected. Cannot be fixed in this repo — requires a correction in the Google Sheet master.

Sheet's Full Name reads "Peripheral Dendritic Cell," but the row's markers (CD123hi, CD303+, low CD33) are the textbook definition of plasmacytoid dendritic cells — likely a wrong word, should probably read "Plasmacytoid." This broke batch lexical search (returned an unrelated "migratory dendritic cell" hit). Cannot be fixed in this repo — requires a correction in the Google Sheet master.

CL:0000576 (plain "monocyte") has zero marker axiom rows in cl_pro_relationships.tsv — same parent-class axiom-gap pattern as NK/ILC/cDC/B cell. Match is lexical-only (OAK-verified), not marker-confirmed.

CL:0000860/CL:0000875/CL:0002393 assert only CCR2 (CD192) and CX3CR1 status plus lineage negatives — none assert the CD14/CD16 axioms that actually define these three subsets per Ziegler-Heitbrock et al. 2010 (PMID:20628149). Already covered by repo issue #12 (filed upstream as CL#3665) — not a new gap, cited here for context on why these rows can only be matched lexically.

Required exclusion column reads "CD56- CD19- ([CD123hi]- CD303-) ([CD123hi|CD193-)" for all four rows — the second group is missing a "]" after CD123hi (likely should read "([CD123hi]-|CD193-)", matching the cDC/pDC pattern). Cannot be fixed in this repo — requires a correction in the Google Sheet master.

CL:0000236 (plain "B cell") has zero marker axiom rows in cl_pro_relationships.tsv — same parent-class axiom-gap pattern as NK/ILC/cDC/monocyte. Match is lexical-only (OAK-verified after OLS4 REST search returned zero hits for this exact query), not marker-confirmed.
